root_trace: AcceptanceBroker.controller_config emits BYO_MCP_ARTIFACT_ROOT, PYOCD_PROBE_UID, PYOCD_TARGET, and PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX, while _scrubbed_environment copies only nonexistent FIRMWARE aliases, so the real child loses every locked lane binding.
controller.main parses three artifact arguments and then unconditionally refuses; it never constructs a broker or executes the artifacts.
The claim is acquired before the only release-guaranteeing finally scope. Evidence/configuration/launcher/cleanup-record failures can leave the exact board claim held.
Daemonized bounded pipe and stderr helpers are not joined or proven stopped before stream closure and claim release.

execute verifies the decision signature over proposal SHA-256 bytes, but AcceptanceBroker.admit verifies the same signature over canonical SHA-256 of a different broker record; a real signature cannot satisfy both payloads.
The focused verifier accepts any nonempty payload and therefore masks the inconsistent signed-message contract.
Authorization accepts a truthy delegated_authority string and permits local C1/governing/seed/target defaults instead of exact path/hash/identity bindings and revocation checks.
The request claim string is never compared with ResourceClaims.held.resource and owner, so the signed/delegated intent does not bind the acquired resource.

required: Use the actual allowlisted broker keys in a scrubbed inherited environment and retain no ambient capability, import injection, project override, or route authority.

Provide a genuinely executable dedicated controller command/API which constructs the broker from exact confined paths, consumes the structured request/proposal/O-decision/C1-delegated authorization flow, uses a real supplied verifier boundary, and invokes the bounded controller without revealing capability to O or target workers.
Define one canonical decision-signature payload and verify exactly those bytes both before launch and at final broker admission; replace permissive payload tests with an exact-message verifier test.

Require closed exact proposal/decision/authorization fields for operative C1/delegated path/hash, attempt/call/lane/board/probe/target/profile/route, governing hashes, seed/target identity, method/version/arguments/policy/plan/permission, public key/topology identity, expiry and one-shot identity. Reject placeholders, mutation, substitution, replay, deny, expiry, revocation, or mismatch before launch.
Bind the proposal's declared exact resource to the acquired ResourceClaims resource/path/hash/owner and carry those exact values through the immutable broker chain.

Put claim acquisition and every subsequent record/configuration/launch/I/O/cleanup/admission path under one outer release boundary. Retain the claim until child identity, termination, exit/reap, cleanup record, and stopped pipe-drain helpers are proved; fail closed on release ambiguity.
Budget all blocking I/O/cancellation/termination against the live call deadline/expiry, safely cancel/kill as required, and prove helper threads cannot outlive cleanup or claim release.

Add focused host-only regressions for exact environment keys, executable entry flow, real canonical signature payload consistency, closed C1/delegated/claim/replay/revocation rejection, record/config/launcher/timeout cleanup, helper teardown, and exact claim release.
